body.x: Sungshin Women’s University Startup SupportGroup participated in the world's largest IT and electronics exhibition CES2020 held in Las Vegas January 7 to 10.

A9, the startup company that participatedwith the support from Sungshin Women’s University Startup Support Group,attracted the attention of many media and buyers by introducing NB-IoT solutionfor single-person households and lonely death management.

Sungshin Women's University Startup SupportGroup consists of a startup education team, startup business support team,investment support team, and startup incubator center. It operates a systematicstartup support program that includes all stages of startup, including thediscovery and training of founders, preparation for startup and startup supportand fostering.

An official from the startup support groupsaid, "You can’t succeed with just a great idea, and it's not easy toparticipate in CES even if your company is receiving attention. That is why wewant to continue to create opportunities to promote companies with great ideasand potential in CES.”

Sungshin Women's Startup Support Groupdiscovered 185 promising startups for four years through the management ofsmart creative site in 2013 and the customized business support project in2015. This lead to about 13.9 billion won worth of revenue from the startups itfostered. Based on this, it was selected as a leading university in startup andpromoted to startup support group in 2017.
